rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: What if another trainer has already captured that God?
rows.a: You do not get it. If the God is still in the deck, it is treated as captured and its God token is removed from the map as well.

rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: Do the health and initiative reductions on an Acolyte's God shrink later?
rows.a: Yes. They shrink as you gain Shards (or, in Ultra Burst, as Ultra Beasts are defeated).

rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: When I obtain a God through an Acolyte's Red ability, do I take another turn as if I had defeated it?
rows.a: No. You did not win a battle, so there is no extra turn.

rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: Who can the Undivided Acolyte (Follower of Arceus) trade with and challenge from a distance?
rows.a: Followers of any God, for both.

rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: Does the Follower of Arceus token also count as 2 cards for the Arceus card's Play 3 effect?
rows.a: Yes. A single Arceus card is enough to use the Play 3 effect.

rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: What state does the new card start in after the Youngster's Career Options?
rows.a: It is Gold straight away, so both abilities are active. The new card's "when unlocked" effects also trigger, Blue first and then Red. The Youngster's abilities are lost.

rows.sectionTitle: Trainer Cards — When Unlocked: Acolytes · Swapping Cards
rows.q: If a card is unlocked in the middle of a battle, when do I make its "when unlocked" choices?
rows.a: Effects with a choice (the card to swap to, the first Weather, the dragon to receive, the Pokémon to release) are chosen after the battle ends or before your next map action. Effects with no choice apply immediately.

rows.q: What faces does the Catch Size Dice have?
What are the Health Dice and Initiative Dice for?
rows.a: In the original they are markers for tracking the health and initiative bonuses that cards give. In this game the bonuses are calculated for you, so the dice have no effect of their own.

rows.q: How high can the Amplifier go?
rows.a: Up to 5 (its values run from 0 to 5).

rows.q: What happens if I release the Pokémon holding the Apex Dragon?
rows.a: The Apex Dragon is lost; it does not return to your bag.

rows.q: Can the Cherish Ball be used on Legendary Pokémon?
rows.a: It can be used on Legendary Pokémon, Alpha Pokémon and Gods in any battle where capture is possible, and it captures without a roll. It cannot be used in trainer battles or on Ultra Beasts.

rows.q: During a battle, can I release a Pokémon captured with the Cherish Ball to get the ball back and use it again?
rows.a: No. You cannot release Pokémon during a battle. If you release it outside of battle, the Cherish Ball returns to you.

rows.q: Can I use the Amplifier after seeing the roll? Can I include the value it gained from that roll?
rows.a: Yes to both. You decide after rolling, and the value gained from that roll is included.

rows.q: Does the Parasol Lady herself pay Journey Points to change the Weather?
rows.a: Yes. Only the first Weather chosen when the card is unlocked is free; after that, everyone pays 3 Journey Points at a Shrine.

rows.q: Can the Pokémon holding Substitute switch in even if my Pokémon in battle is Frozen?
rows.a: Yes.

rows.q: How is damage calculated when a Pokémon switches in with Substitute?
rows.a: The dice stay as rolled, and type effectiveness and modifiers are worked out again for the Pokémon that switched in. That Pokémon also receives the attack's other effects.

rows.q: What if the Legendary Pokémon of the Legendary Location the Tourist wants to stamp is not in the deck?
rows.a: You stamp the sheet but do not get a Legendary Snap. You can stamp it even without the Artifact.

rows.q: Is a move taught from a Legendary Snap treated like a normal move card?
rows.a: Yes. It counts as a normal move card.

rows.q: Can trainer card abilities be used in battles against Ultra Beasts and Necrozma and in Lake trials?
rows.a: Yes. Trainer card abilities work as written in every battle of both campaigns.

rows.q: When can the Lady's Hyper Potion be used in battle? Does using it end my turn?
rows.a: Only on your turn, when you are choosing an action. It does not use up your turn, so after healing you go on to choose your action.

rows.q: Can a capture roll for Team Rocket's Pokémon Thief be rerolled with Dialga's Change of Fate?
rows.a: No. A capture roll made to take another trainer's Pokémon cannot be rerolled.

rows.q: Can I send out a Pokémon stolen with Pokémon Thief in that same battle?
rows.a: No. A stolen Pokémon cannot be sent out until that battle is over. After the battle, it is yours to use.

rows.q: If I steal a Pokémon holding 2 Held Items with Pokémon Thief, what happens to the second Held Item?
rows.a: As with a trade, the second Held Item goes into the bag of the trainer who took the Pokémon. If that trainer is a Backpacker with Holding Capacity unlocked, the Pokémon keeps holding both.

rows.q: Can a Pokémon with a Distortion Breach card attached be stolen with Pokémon Thief?
rows.a: No. You cannot take any action that would make a Distortion Breach card leave the party, so a Pokémon with one attached cannot be stolen.

rows.q: Does the +2 attack strength from the Parasol Lady's Weather Wheel apply to every Pokémon's moves?
rows.a: No. It only applies to moves used by the Pokémon of the trainer who owns the Weather Wheel, not to wild Pokémon or other trainers' moves.

rows.q: If I use the Worker's Civil Engineer partway through my turn, are Roads built on the tiles I already passed?
rows.a: Yes. Roads are built on every tile you walked onto this turn, including those from before you used the ability. The tile where you started the turn was not walked onto, so it gets no Road.

rows.q: What exactly can I do on a tile with the Psychic's Telekinetic Reach?
rows.a: Anything you could do if you were standing on that tile: searching, picking up Apricorns, revealing a Hidden Spot, making a Shrine Offering (including offering extra Journey Points) and changing the Weather, restoring, the Ginkgo Merchants, Fly from a village, challenging, and crossing a Distortion Gate.

rows.q: Can I trade with a distant trainer using Telekinetic Reach?
rows.a: Yes. On your turn you can propose a trade to a trainer within 2 tiles. Proposing it uses the ability for that turn.

rows.q: Where do I end up if I use a distant Distortion Gate with Telekinetic Reach?
rows.a: On the tile of the gate at the other end.

rows.q: Whose turn ends after a Big Scoop battle?
rows.a: If one of the two battling trainers is the trainer whose turn it is, that turn ends. If it is neither trainer's turn, they just battle and the turn in progress carries on.

rows.q: What happens with Big Scoop when several trainers gain stamps at once?
rows.a: You are asked about a challenge for each stamp gained, one at a time. Any that have not been asked by the end of the turn are lost.

rows.q: In Ultra Burst, what is an "empty slot" for the Pokémon Ranger's Pokémon Ranch?
rows.a: A party slot with no Pokémon in it. Each such slot can store up to 2 Distortion Breach cards.

rows.q: Does the Pokémon Ranger have to store the Breach cards received?
rows.a: No. If there is room to store one, you choose whether to store it or attach it to a Pokémon when the card is to be attached.

rows.q: Can I take out a stored Breach card later and attach it?
rows.a: Yes. On your turn, outside of battle, you can take stored cards out one at a time and attach them to a Pokémon. Once attached, a card cannot be stored again.

rows.q: What happens when a Pokémon enters an empty slot that is storing Breach cards?
rows.a: There is now less room, so the cards that no longer fit return to your hand and must be attached to a Pokémon at the start of your next turn.

rows.q: Do Apricorn Trees removed with the Kindler's Gather Firewood count towards Breach Strength?
rows.a: No. A removed tree is not counted as destroyed, and it is also left out of the total used to work out Breach Strength. Ultra Beasts and Necrozma do not target it either.

rows.q: Does the Ultra Burst campaign have Acts or Team Galactic Grunts?
rows.a: No. The campaign isn't split into Acts, and there are no Team Galactic Grunts at your home village.

rows.q: How much movement do you start with in Ultra Burst?
rows.a: 3. You don't get the movement bonuses of the Heart of Sinnoh campaign, but the Lake Guardians can raise it.

rows.q: Where do the nine Ultra Beasts start?
rows.a: Each is placed on a wild tile of Sinnoh that matches its habitat (biome and climate), spread out across different regions. No hidden spot is placed on a tile where an Ultra Beast stands.

rows.q: When do the Ultra Beasts take their turn in a solo game?
rows.a: At the end of each of your turns. With several players, it comes each time everyone has taken one turn.

rows.q: Can you cross a Distortion Gate with 0 movement? Can you cross more than once in a turn?
rows.a: Yes. Gates cost no movement, so you can cross with 0 movement, and there is no limit on how often. Your turn continues after crossing.

rows.q: Can you cross from a Distortion Gate tile without battling?
rows.a: Yes. You can use the gate without fighting the Swarm Battle.

rows.q: Can you reach the Distortion World through a Distortion Gate in the Heart of Sinnoh campaign?
rows.a: No. Crossing through gates is only possible in the Ultra Burst campaign.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: Which way do Ultra Beasts move?
rows.a: They pick a wild tile among the adjacent tiles, preferring tiles with a hidden spot, a Shrine, or an Apricorn Tree or Reef. They avoid villages, Legendary Locations and Legendary Pokémon, trainers, other Ultra Beasts, places already destroyed, and tiles an Ultra Beast has already crossed that turn. Ties are broken at random.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: Are Shrines and trees destroyed on a tile the Ultra Beast doesn't actually enter?
rows.a: Yes. Ultra Beasts only move onto wild tiles, but even if the tile they pick isn't a wild tile, its hidden spot is sent to the Distortion World and its Shrine, tree or reef is destroyed.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: If Breach Strength rises past 10% during a turn, do the Ultra Beasts move further that same turn?
rows.a: No. The number of tiles they move that turn is set by the Breach Strength at the start of the turn.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: What happens if a trainer is standing on a tile Necrozma targets?
rows.a: The tree, reef or Shrine on that tile is destroyed all the same.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: Do eliminated trainers count when working out how many tiles Necrozma targets?
rows.a: Yes. Eliminated trainers still count towards the number of players.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: How is Breach Strength calculated?
rows.a: It is the number of destroyed Shrines, Apricorn Trees and Reefs divided by the total number of Shrines, trees and reefs on the board, as a percentage.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: If Breach Strength crosses two 10% increments in one turn, how many Distortion Breach cards are you dealt?
rows.a: One for each increment crossed, so 2 cards.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: Are eliminated trainers dealt Distortion Breach cards too?
rows.a: Yes. The cards pile up in their hand and are attached after they are revived. Cards dealt are shown to everyone.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beasts' Turn · Breach
rows.q: What happens when Breach Strength reaches 70%? Does Necrozma get stronger?
rows.a: Everyone loses at once, at the end of that Ultra Beasts' turn.

rows.q: Does a Distortion Breach card take up a move slot?
rows.a: Yes. While it is attached, one of that Pokémon's move slots is blocked and no move can be taught to it.

rows.q: Can one Pokémon have 2 Distortion Breach cards attached?
rows.a: Yes, up to 2.

rows.q: When you attach breach cards to a Legendary Pokémon, which Legendary tactic is covered first?
rows.a: The first card covers Alpha Strike and the second covers Beast Boost.

rows.q: If you have no empty move slot, can you skip attaching a Distortion Breach card?
rows.a: No. You must discard a taught move and attach the card in that slot. You may also discard a move to attach it even when you have an empty slot. It can't go in a slot that already holds another breach card.

rows.q: When do you attach the Distortion Breach cards you were dealt?
rows.a: At the start of the next turn, whoever's turn it is. If every move slot is filled with breach cards, you keep the card in your hand and attach it at the start of the next turn after a slot opens up.

rows.q: Can you release or trade a Pokémon with a Distortion Breach card attached?
rows.a: No. Releasing, trading and the Shrine's Equivalent Exchange are all unavailable.

rows.q: Can you remove a Distortion Breach card when the Pokémon evolves?
rows.a: No. The Pokémon can evolve, but the card stays. You must keep it until an Ultra Beast is defeated.

rows.q: When an Ultra Beast is defeated, can you move a breach card to another trainer's Pokémon?
rows.a: No. You can only move it to another Pokémon in your own party.

rows.q: When an Ultra Beast is defeated, can you also discard a breach card that is still in your hand?
rows.a: Yes. Cards in your hand and cards stored by the Pokémon Ranger can be discarded as well. Only attached cards can be moved.

rows.q: Can you discard or move a breach card after defeating one phase of Necrozma?
rows.a: No. Only when you defeat one of the nine Ultra Beasts.

rows.q: After defeating an Ultra Beast and discarding a breach card, can you teach that Ultra Beast's move to the freed slot right away?
rows.a: Yes. The move is taught after you discard or move the card, so it can go in the slot you just freed.

rows.q: Do two copies of the same Distortion Breach card stack on one Pokémon?
rows.a: Yes, they stack.

rows.q: Is the +2 damage from Reckless Assault added before damage is doubled?
rows.a: Yes. It is added to the positive type effectiveness damage, so it goes in before the damage is doubled.

rows.q: When two Pokémon with Rapid Strikes meet, which acts first?
rows.a: Initiative is compared as usual.

rows.q: If removing Gravitational Drag lowers a Pokémon's maximum health, does it faint?
rows.a: If the damage it has taken is equal to or greater than its reduced maximum health, it stays at 0 health until it is healed.

rows.q: Does switching out after attacking with Nimble Frame change the turn order? Can you switch even when an effect prevents switching?
rows.a: The order stays the same, so your opponent goes next. You can't switch out if an effect such as the Frozen status prevents switching.

rows.q: Does a Pokémon with Chromatic Union get the same-type move bonus?
rows.a: No. Every move it uses becomes Typeless, including moves that pick a type such as Alpha Strike, so there is neither type effectiveness nor a same-type bonus.

rows.q: Does Status Overload also trigger the first time the Pokémon enters the battle?
rows.a: Yes. It triggers every time the Pokémon switches in. If the opposing Pokémon isn't out yet, the status dice is rolled right after it comes out.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beast Battles · Prism Armour
rows.q: What happens if you lose to an Ultra Beast? Are you eliminated?
rows.a: You are not eliminated. You return to your home village as usual and the Ultra Beast stays where it is. It doesn't get an extra turn of movement either.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beast Battles · Prism Armour
rows.q: What do you get for defeating an Ultra Beast?
rows.a: The same as for defeating a Legendary Pokémon: 6 Journey Points, and you may teach that Ultra Beast's signature move.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beast Battles · Prism Armour
rows.q: Do you get an extra turn for defeating an Ultra Beast?
rows.a: No. Your turn ends when the battle ends.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Ultra Beast Battles · Prism Armour
rows.q: Does Prism Armour reduce the damage of each attack separately?
rows.a: No. It reduces the total damage taken in one turn. For example, if you would take 5 on your own turn from recoil and Poisoned damage combined and Prism Armour reduces it by 2, you take 3.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: Do you get Journey Points or a move for defeating one phase of Necrozma?
rows.a: No. Necrozma hasn't fainted until Phase 3 is defeated, so defeating Phase 1 or 2 gives no Journey Points, move or Journey Stamp. Prism Armour doesn't move either.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: After defeating a phase, can you go on to fight the next phase in the same turn?
rows.a: No. Defeating a phase ends the battle and your turn.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: Are you eliminated if you forfeit a battle against Necrozma?
rows.a: Yes. If a battle against Necrozma ends without you winning it, you are eliminated, even by forfeit.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: What can an eliminated trainer do?
rows.a: They take no turns and can't be challenged or traded with. They can still propose using a Blessing of Arceus.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: Who can use a Blessing of Arceus, and when?
rows.a: Anyone can propose it. With several players, every other trainer who hasn't been eliminated is asked, and it isn't used if even one of them blocks it. If there is no one to ask, or everyone has been eliminated and you are reviving, it is used at once without asking.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: How is skipping the Ultra Beasts' turn decided?
rows.a: While a Blessing remains, every trainer who hasn't been eliminated is asked at the end of each round, and if more than half choose "Skip", 1 Blessing is spent to skip the turn. On a tie it is not skipped. In a solo game your answer decides.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: What doesn't happen when the Ultra Beasts' turn is skipped?
rows.a: The whole turn is gone: the Ultra Beasts don't move, Necrozma destroys nothing, and no Distortion Breach cards are dealt. Only one turn can be skipped at a time.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: Where does a revived trainer start again?
rows.a: At their home village.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: Is your party healed when you are revived? Do you get a Change of Fate card too?
rows.a: Your whole party is healed the moment you are revived. You don't get a Change of Fate card.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: What happens if every trainer is eliminated?
rows.a: With no Blessing left, everyone loses. If a Blessing remains, 1 is spent on a revival; with several players, the last trainer eliminated chooses who is revived.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Necrozma · Elimination · Blessing of Arceus
rows.q: If Necrozma is defeated, do eliminated trainers win too?
rows.a: Yes. When Phase 3 is defeated, everyone wins, eliminated trainers included.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: Can you inflict a status effect on a Lake Guardian before its trial is overcome?
rows.a: Yes. It only ignores damage and capture attempts; status effects still apply. It takes no damage from the likes of Poisoned or battle fatigue.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: Does the attack that overcomes the trial deal its damage?
rows.a: No. The Guardian takes no damage through the turn the trial is overcome; damage and capture work from the following turn.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: Does the trial have to be overcome again in every battle?
rows.a: No. Once per game. After someone has overcome it, that Guardian can be damaged and captured from the start of any later battle, whoever fights it.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: If the battle ends before you finish the trial, is your progress kept?
rows.a: No. You have to start over in the next battle.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: Can you challenge a Lake Guardian again after losing or fleeing?
rows.a: Yes. The Guardian stays in its Lake Cavern, so you can challenge it again. If you win, you get 6 Journey Points and its move as with any other Legendary Pokémon; if you capture it, it joins your party.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: How do you overcome the Trial of Emotion when Mesprit takes no damage?
rows.a: It counts as overcome once Mesprit would take battle fatigue damage. That damage isn't actually dealt.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: In the Trial of Knowledge, do the 2 different types have to come from one Pokémon?
rows.a: No. Attacks from any of your Pokémon in that battle count. Each type counts only once, and moves that pick a type, such as Alpha Strike, count as the type picked.

rows.sectionTitle: Ultra Burst — Lake Trials · The Temple of Sinnoh
rows.q: Does the Trial of Willpower need 2 critical hits in a single attack?
rows.a: No. You need 2 or more critical hits in total across your last 2 turns' attack rolls. Two in one turn works, and so does one in each of two turns in a row.

rows.q: Do you draw Ultra Onslaught cards in battles against the Lake Guardians or Silvally?
rows.a: No. They are only drawn in battles against the Ultra Beasts and Necrozma.

rows.q: If the "Do not attack this turn. Heal 4 damage and all status effects." card comes up while the opponent is Poisoned, does it still heal?
rows.a: Yes. Status effects are removed first, then it heals 4 health. It counts as not having used a move that turn, so its Alpha Strike next turn is not weakened.

rows.q: Does the "Replace all status symbols with critical hits." card also turn status symbols created by the Drowsy status into critical hits?
rows.a: Yes. Every status symbol still showing after other effects have changed the dice becomes a critical hit.

rows.q: How much damage does the "When next attacked, all regular hits damage the attacker as well." card deal?
rows.a: Once, the next time it is attacked: the attacking Pokémon takes 1 damage for each regular hit in that attack roll.

rows.q: With the "Use Alpha Strike twice this turn." card, what is the attack strength of the second Alpha Strike?
rows.a: 2. Alpha Strike loses attack strength when used twice in a row.

rows.q: What happens to the second Alpha Strike if my Pokémon faints to the first?
rows.a: Your next Pokémon out takes the second Alpha Strike. If you have no Pokémon left to send out, the battle ends.

rows.q: Does the "Deal double damage" card count Distortion Breach cards that are only in your hand? Does it stack with a move's double damage?
rows.a: Only cards attached to the Pokémon count. Double damage applies just once, so it doesn't stack with a move's doubling.
